title: Spring Storm Season — Why Roofing Territory Presence Wins Before the Hail Hits
content:
###  **The Post-Storm Scramble** 

Every roofing company knows what happens after a spring hailstorm hits the North Shore. Trucks appear from three counties away. Yard signs multiply overnight. Homeowners are flooded with knocks, flyers, and pitches — and they trust none of it. 

Storm chasers have trained homeowners in Wilmette, Winnetka, Glencoe, and Highland Park to be suspicious of any roofing company they meet for the first time after damage occurs. 

###  **Who Actually Gets the Call** 

The company that wins the post-storm call is the one the homeowner already recognized before the storm. The brand they encountered on their street in October. The QR card that led to a free inspection in March. The name that feels local rather than opportunistic. 

That recognition cannot be built after the storm. It has to already exist — which is why roofing territory presence is a pre-season investment, not a post-storm reaction. 

###  **The Free Inspection Advantage** 

SIT GroundForce™ Territory Representatives lead with prevention: free inspection scheduling through QR code placement, conversations about home maintenance and early detection. A homeowner who scheduled a preventive inspection in April already has a relationship with your company when the May storm hits. The post-storm call is not a cold call — it is a follow-up. 

###  **Securing Roofing Territory Before the Season** 

One roofing partner per defined territory. When your category is approved in your ZIP codes, it closes to other roofing companies in the SIT™ program. The companies that secure territory in early spring own the recognition when storm season arrives.
